explanation: Each grape is said to bring luck for one month of the coming year. The custom spread to much of Latin America, and many Spaniards follow the chimes from Madrid's Puerta del Sol.

claims.text: In Spain, it is a New Year's Eve custom to eat 12 grapes, one at each stroke of midnight.
The Spanish New Year custom does not involve olives, almonds or cherries.
Each of the 12 grapes is said to bring luck for one month of the coming year.
The custom has spread to many Latin American countries.
Many Spaniards time their grapes to the midnight chimes of the clock at Madrid's Puerta del Sol.
